steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Create project folder structure and add basic files (index.html, style.css, script.js).

steps.title: Add Tailwind CSS via CDN
steps.description: Insert Tailwind CSS browser CDN link into index.html for styling.

steps.title: Create Layout Skeleton
steps.description: Build the main layout with a header, navigation, main content area, and footer using Tailwind utilities.

steps.title: Design Billing Form UI
steps.description: Add a form for entering client, item description, quantity, and price. Use Tailwind components for responsive design.

steps.title: Create Invoice Table
steps.description: Add an empty table that will display added line items with calculated totals.

steps.title: Implement Add Item Logic
steps.description: Write JavaScript to capture form data, validate inputs, calculate line total, and append a row to the invoice table.

steps.title: Calculate Subtotal, Tax, and Grand Total
steps.description: Add functions that sum line totals, compute tax (10%), and display the grand total dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Remove Item Feature
steps.description: Allow each row to be removed with a delete button, updating totals accordingly.

steps.title: Add Print / Download Capability
steps.description: Provide a button that triggers window.print() for a printable invoice view.

steps.title: Responsive Enhancements
steps.description: Fine‑tune layout for mobile devices using Tailwind's responsive utilities.

steps.title: Polish UI & Accessibility
steps.description: Add focus states, ARIA labels, and improve color contrast for better accessibility.

steps.title: Building BillingPro
steps.description: Final build and deployment of the BillingPro app.
